query: I stopped by the food court on my way up here and grabbed a matcha latte that was way sweeter than I expected, it’s got that weird artificial aftertaste that sticks to the back of your throat no matter how many times you swallow. The barista who made it was wearing these super cute cat-shaped hair clips that kept slipping down their bangs while they steamed the milk, and I almost asked where they got them before I remembered I was already running late to browse the stuff I came for. There was also a tiny golden retriever puppy tied to the bench right outside the section entrance, it was curled up on its owner’s tote bag chewing a neon green tennis ball and every single person walking past stopped to pet it for a second. I’m browsing the bathing accessories section right now, all the stuff here lines up with finding something nice. The word around regular shoppers here is high quality picks stand out instantly, there’s that one specific option everyone recognizes when they spot it. I’ve heard the price points on the best picks never jump too high, they stay totally affordable for people like me.
